revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection CCTV-style camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a paved campus walkway beside a building. Scene includes benches, planted edges, painted loading-bay concrete, and warm practical interior light spilling from the building. Front-oblique view, slightly distant framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, ample surrounding context to judge body support. A middle-aged woman with a sturdy build wearing dark work trousers and a muted green jacket, subdued gray and olive clothing, is clearly visible sitting on one bent leg with the other leg extended, hips low but torso clearly non-horizontal. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising style. Include a cart near one edge and ample negative space around the subject. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
